description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of different methods—RPG (CodeLlama-7B), Greedy (CodeLlama-34B), and RPG (CodeLlama-34B)—across four code generation evaluation metrics: EGP ↑, TR-N ↓, TR-S ↓, and CCP ↑, where upward arrows indicate higher is better and downward arrows indicate lower is better. The vertical axis represents performance, scaled from 0.0 to 1.0 in increments of 0.2. The horizontal axis lists the four metrics. For EGP ↑, RPG (CodeLlama-7B) achieves approximately 0.89, Greedy (CodeLlama-34B) reaches 0.60, and RPG (CodeLlama-34B) peaks at 1.0. In TR-N ↓, RPG (CodeLlama-7B) scores ~0.70, Greedy (CodeLlama-34B) ~0.62, and RPG (CodeLlama-34B) ~0.41. For TR-S ↓, RPG (CodeLlama-7B) is ~0.69, Greedy (CodeLlama-34B) ~0.45, and RPG (CodeLlama-34B) ~0.31. In CCP ↑, RPG (CodeLlama-7B) scores ~0.41, Greedy (CodeLlama-34B) ~0.70, and RPG (CodeLlama-34B) ~0.94. The chart visually emphasizes that RPG (CodeLlama-34B) consistently outperforms or matches other methods across all metrics, particularly excelling in EGP and CCP, while Greedy (CodeLlama-34B) underperforms in TR-N and TR-S compared to RPG variants. The legend clarifies color coding: blue for RPG (CodeLlama-7B), orange for RPG (CodeLlama-7B), green for Greedy (CodeLlama-34B), and red for RPG (CodeLlama-34B).
